recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not duplicate the THO CodeSystem concept locally in core; any remaining action should be THO/UTG release or package coordination rather than a core source edit.
issue_request: FHIR-50889 is Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asks to add symptoms to Observation.category because symptoms are patient observations, visual observations, or sensations not clearly represented by existing Observation category codes.
initial_application: No core source commit mentioning FHIR-50889 was found. The Jira resolution says the fix is the same as FHIR-34408, and a later comment says the work is covered by UP-738. Current core source already imports the external THO observation-category CodeSystem through source/observation/valueset-observation-category.xml and binds Observation.category to that ValueSet.
additional_context: FHIR-34408, FHIR-37560, and FHIR-52872 are the same symptom Observation category change family. UP-738 is Proposal Implemented and updated the UTG/THO source-of-truth CodeSystem; its comments explicitly include FHIR-50889 as an additional symptom ticket. OO minutes and Zulip announcements support the same external terminology path. The combined branch already contains an external-repo audit commit for related FHIR-52872, but had no FHIR-50889 reconcile commit before this one.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because core delegates the category code list to THO, and current THO plus the current FHIR build expansion already include symptom.
